sloka: व्रतं सुनिश्चयं ह्येतन्मया ह्युत्पादितं पुरा ।तत्सखित्वं मया सौम्य रोचयस्व धनेश्वर ।। ७.१३.२९ ॥
transliteration: vrataṁ suniścayaṁ hyetanmayā hyutpāditaṁ purā ।tatsakhitvaṁ mayā saumya rocayasva dhaneśvara ।। 7.13.29 ॥

translations.english: This very firm vow was indeed originated by me in the past, therefore, O gentle lord of wealth, desire friendship with me.
